title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated October 16, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $22,000.00 to
text:
[4. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated October 16, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $22,000.00 to
  fund equipment and training for Metropolitan Division, as set forth.  [BPC #26-325]

  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s report.

Board of Police Commissioners – Agenda  Page 2  November 3, 2026
summary: The commission is asked to approve a report on a $22,000 donation that will fund equipment and training for the Metropolitan Division.
